23
Ahwɛfoɔ bɔne ne ɔhwɛfoɔ pa
1 # Hes 13.2-16; 34; Sak 11.5 Nnwanhwɛfoɔ a wɔsɛe me nnwankuo bɔ wɔn pete no nnue! AWURADE asɛm nie. 2Enti sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn ka wɔ ahwɛfoɔ a wɔhwɛ me man no ho nie: Mo na moabɔ me nnwankuo no apete, na moapansam wɔn, na moanhwɛ wɔn. Hwɛ, mo na merebɛtua mo mo nneyɛɛ mu bɔne no so ka, AWURADE asɛm nie. 3Na me ara mɛboa me nnwan nkaeɛ ano afiri nsase a mapam wɔn akɔ soɔ no nyinaa so, na mede wɔn bɛsane aba wɔn adidibea bio, na wɔbɛwowo na wɔadɔ. 4#Yer 3.15 Na mɛsisi wɔn so ahwɛfoɔ na wɔahwɛ wɔn, na wɔrensuro bio, na wɔn akoma rentu, na wɔn mu bi renyera, AWURADE asɛm nie.
5 # Sak 3.8; 6.12; Yes 32.1 Hwɛ, nna bi reba, AWURADE asɛm nie, sɛ mɛma tenenee Duban bi so mama Dawid, na ɔbɛdi hene nimdeɛ so, na wabu atɛntenenee ayɛ ade tenenee asase no so. 6#Yer 33.16 Ne berɛ so na wɔbɛgye Yuda nkwa, na Israel atena ase dwoodwoo, na yei ne ne din a wɔde bɛfrɛ no: AWURADE yɛn tenenee.
7 # Yer 16.14-15 Ɛno nti, hwɛ, AWURADE asɛm nie, nna bi reba a wɔrenka bio sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE a ɔyii Israel firii Misraim asase so baeɛ no te aseɛ yi, 8na mmom: Sɛ AWURADE a ɔkɔyii Israel fie asefoɔ firii atifi fam asase ne nsase a mepamm wɔn kɔɔ soɔ no nyinaa so baeɛ no te aseɛ yi! Na wɔbɛtena wɔn ankasa asase so.
Adiyifoɔ atorofoɔ no
9Adiyifoɔ no ho asɛm nie:
M’akoma abubu me yam,
me nnompe nyinaa sa biribiri;
mayɛ sɛ nsaboni ne ɔbarima a waboro nsa,
AWURADE ne ne nsɛm kronkron no nti.
10Na awaresɛefoɔ ahyɛ asase no so ma;
na nnome nti asase no di abooboo,
ɛserɛ so adidibea akusa;
na wɔn mmirikatuo yɛ bɔne,
na wɔn mmaninyɛ nso ntene.
11Na odiyifoɔ ne ɔsɔfoɔ nyinaa nsuro Nyame,
me fie mpo na mahunu wɔn bɔne,
AWURADE asɛm nie.
12 # Yer 13.16; Dwom 35.6 Ɛno nti wɔn kwan bɛyɛ wɔn sɛ
esum kabii mu kwan torotoro,
wɔbɛsunsum wɔn na wɔahwehwe ɛso ase,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔn asotwe afe no mu,
mede bɔne bɛba wɔn so,
AWURADE asɛm nie.
13Na Samaria adiyifoɔ no mu,
mahunu nkwaseasɛm,
wɔde Baal hyɛɛ nkɔm de
maa me man Israel fomee.
14 # Hes 13.22; Yes 1.10 Na Yerusalem adiyifoɔ no mu nso
mahunu ahodwirideɛ,
wɔsɛe awareɛ na wɔdi atorɔ,
na wɔhyɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nsa den,
sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na obiara ansane amfiri ne bɔne mu;
wɔn nyinaa adane me sɛ Sodom,
na emufoɔ ayɛ sɛ Gomora.
15 # Yer 9.15 Enti sɛ asafo AWURADE ka no adiyifoɔ no ho nie:
Hwɛ, merema wɔn bɔnwono adi,
na mama wɔn ɛborɔ nsuo anom,
ɛfiri sɛ Yerusalem adiyifoɔ mu abɔnefosɛm
afiri kɔ asase no nyinaa so.
16 # Yer 6.14 Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Monntie adiyifoɔ a wɔhyɛ mo nkɔm no nsɛm, wɔde mo kɔ ahuhudeɛ mu. Wɔn adwene mu anisoadehunu na wɔka, ɛmfiri AWURADE anomu. 17#Yer 7.24 Ka na wɔka kyerɛ wɔn a wɔpo me no sɛ: AWURADE se: Asomdwoeɛ bɛba ama mo. Na obiara nante n’akoma denyɛ mu a, wɔse: Bɔne biara remma mo so.
18 # Yes 40.13 Na wɔn mu hwan na wagyina AWURADE agyina no mu,
na wahunu na wate n’asɛm,
anaa hwan na wawɛn n’aso atie n’asɛm?
19 # Yer 30.23 Hwɛ, AWURADE ahum,
abufuhyeɛ afiri adi,
na ahum a ɛdi kyinhyia
no bɛtwa ne ho abɛsi abɔnefoɔ tiri so.
20AWURADE abufuo no rensane
kɔsi sɛ ɛbɛwie na ama n’akoma mu adwene agyina;
nna a ɛdi akyire no mu no
na mobɛhunu mu pefee.
21 # Yer 14.14 Mansoma adiyifoɔ no,
nso wɔnyaa asɛm kɔkaeɛ;
mankasa mankyerɛ wɔn,
nso wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm.
22Na sɛ wɔgyinaa m’agyina mu a,
anka wɔmaa me man tiee me nsɛm,
na wɔasane wɔn afiri wɔn kwammɔne so
ne wɔn nneyɛɛ bɔne no ho.
23Meyɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ mpinkyɛeɛ mu, AWURADE asɛm nie, na menyɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ akyirikyiri anaa? 24Sɛ obi de ne ho hunta huntabea bi a, merenhu no anaa? AWURADE asɛm nie. Ɛnyɛ ɔsoro ne asase na mayɛ so ma anaa? AWURADE asɛm nie. 25Mate deɛ adiyifoɔ a wɔde me din hyɛ nkɔntorɔ no keka sɛ: Maso daeɛ, maso daeɛ! no. 26Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn? Ɛwɔ adiyifoɔ a wɔka atorɔ adiyisɛm, na wɔka wɔn akoma mu nnaadaa nkɔm no akoma mu, 27wɔdwene sɛ wɔbɛma me man werɛ afiri me din, wɔn adaeɛ a wɔkeka kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho no nti, sɛdeɛ Baal nti wɔn agyanom werɛ firii me din no? 28Odiyifoɔ a ɔso daeɛ no, ma no nka ne daeɛso, na deɛ m’asɛm wɔ ne hɔ no, ma no nka m’asɛm nokorɛ mu. Ɛdeɛn na ntɛtɛ ne ayuo wɔ yɛ? AWURADE asɛm nie. 29#Heb 4.12 M’asɛm nte sɛ ogya? AWURADE asɛm nie, na ɛnte sɛ asaeɛ a ɛbobɔ ɔbotan anaa? 30Enti, hwɛ, me ne adiyifoɔ no anya, AWURADE asɛm nie, nnipa a wɔwiawia me nsɛm wɔn yɔnkonom nkyɛn no. 31Hwɛ, me ne adiyifoɔ no anya, AWURADE asɛm nie, wɔn a wɔde wɔn tɛkyerɛma keka sɛ: AWURADE se, no. 32#Yer 23.21 Hwɛ, me ne adiyifoɔ a wɔsoso atorɔ adaeɛ no anya, AWURADE asɛm nie; wɔn deɛ, wɔkeka adaeɛ no, na wɔde wɔn atorosɛm ne wɔn adwenharesɛm daadaa me man no, nanso mensomaa wɔn, na menhyɛɛ wɔn, na wɔn ho remma ɔman yi mfasoɔ biara, AWURADE asɛm nie.
33Na sɛ ɔman yi, anaa odiyifoɔ anaa ɔsɔfoɔ bi bisa wo sɛ: AWURADE adesoa ne deɛn? Ɛnneɛ kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Wone adesoa no, na mɛto wo matwene, AWURADE asɛm nie. 34Na odiyifoɔ anaa ɔsɔfoɔ anaa ɔman no mu nipa biara ka sɛ: AWURADE adesoa a, na mɛba mabɛtwe onii ko no ne ne fie aso. 35Sei na monkeka nkyerɛ mo mfɛfoɔ, na onua nka nkyerɛ ne nua: Ɛdeɛn na AWURADE buaeɛ, na ɛdeɛn na AWURADE aka? 36Na AWURADE adesoa no deɛ, mommmɔ din bio, na obiara asɛm bɛdane no adesoa, ɛfiri sɛ moadanedane Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ, asafo AWURADE, yɛn Nyankopɔn nsɛm ani. 37Sei na ka kyerɛ odiyifoɔ no: Ɛdeɛn na AWURADE de buaa woɔ, na ɛdeɛn na AWURADE aka? 38Na sɛ moka sɛ: AWURADE adesoa no nti, sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɛsiane sɛ moka asɛm yi sɛ AWURADE adesoa no, na mesomaa mo nkyɛn sɛ: Monnka sɛ: AWURADE adesoa no, 39enti, hwɛ, me werɛ bɛfiri mo koraa, na mato mo ne kuro a mede memaa mo ne mo agyanom no afiri m’anim agu.
40 # Yer 20.11 Na mede daa ahohora ne daa nsopa a werɛ remfiri da ato mo so.

pageProps.chapterText:
Nnwanhwɛfoɔ a wɔsɛe me nnwankuo bɔ wɔn pete no nnue! AWURADE asɛm nie. Enti sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn ka wɔ ahwɛfoɔ a wɔhwɛ me man no ho nie: Mo na moabɔ me nnwankuo no apete, na moapansam wɔn, na moanhwɛ wɔn. Hwɛ, mo na merebɛtua mo mo nneyɛɛ mu bɔne no so ka, AWURADE asɛm nie. Na me ara mɛboa me nnwan nkaeɛ ano afiri nsase a mapam wɔn akɔ soɔ no nyinaa so, na mede wɔn bɛsane aba wɔn adidibea bio, na wɔbɛwowo na wɔadɔ. Na mɛsisi wɔn so ahwɛfoɔ na wɔahwɛ wɔn, na wɔrensuro bio, na wɔn akoma rentu, na wɔn mu bi renyera, AWURADE asɛm nie.
Hwɛ, nna bi reba, AWURADE asɛm nie, sɛ mɛma tenenee Duban bi so mama Dawid, na ɔbɛdi hene nimdeɛ so, na wabu atɛntenenee ayɛ ade tenenee asase no so. Ne berɛ so na wɔbɛgye Yuda nkwa, na Israel atena ase dwoodwoo, na yei ne ne din a wɔde bɛfrɛ no: AWURADE yɛn tenenee.
Ɛno nti, hwɛ, AWURADE asɛm nie, nna bi reba a wɔrenka bio sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE a ɔyii Israel firii Misraim asase so baeɛ no te aseɛ yi, na mmom: Sɛ AWURADE a ɔkɔyii Israel fie asefoɔ firii atifi fam asase ne nsase a mepamm wɔn kɔɔ soɔ no nyinaa so baeɛ no te aseɛ yi! Na wɔbɛtena wɔn ankasa asase so.

Adiyifoɔ no ho asɛm nie:
M’akoma abubu me yam,
me nnompe nyinaa sa biribiri;
mayɛ sɛ nsaboni ne ɔbarima a waboro nsa,
AWURADE ne ne nsɛm kronkron no nti.
Na awaresɛefoɔ ahyɛ asase no so ma;
na nnome nti asase no di abooboo,
ɛserɛ so adidibea akusa;
na wɔn mmirikatuo yɛ bɔne,
na wɔn mmaninyɛ nso ntene.
Na odiyifoɔ ne ɔsɔfoɔ nyinaa nsuro Nyame,
me fie mpo na mahunu wɔn bɔne,
AWURADE asɛm nie.
Ɛno nti wɔn kwan bɛyɛ wɔn sɛ
esum kabii mu kwan torotoro,
wɔbɛsunsum wɔn na wɔahwehwe ɛso ase,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔn asotwe afe no mu,
mede bɔne bɛba wɔn so,
AWURADE asɛm nie.
Na Samaria adiyifoɔ no mu,
mahunu nkwaseasɛm,
wɔde Baal hyɛɛ nkɔm de
maa me man Israel fomee.
Na Yerusalem adiyifoɔ no mu nso
mahunu ahodwirideɛ,
wɔsɛe awareɛ na wɔdi atorɔ,
na wɔhyɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nsa den,
sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na obiara ansane amfiri ne bɔne mu;
wɔn nyinaa adane me sɛ Sodom,
na emufoɔ ayɛ sɛ Gomora.
Enti sɛ asafo AWURADE ka no adiyifoɔ no ho nie:
Hwɛ, merema wɔn bɔnwono adi,
na mama wɔn ɛborɔ nsuo anom,
ɛfiri sɛ Yerusalem adiyifoɔ mu abɔnefosɛm
afiri kɔ asase no nyinaa so.
Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Monntie adiyifoɔ a wɔhyɛ mo nkɔm no nsɛm, wɔde mo kɔ ahuhudeɛ mu. Wɔn adwene mu anisoadehunu na wɔka, ɛmfiri AWURADE anomu. Ka na wɔka kyerɛ wɔn a wɔpo me no sɛ: AWURADE se: Asomdwoeɛ bɛba ama mo. Na obiara nante n’akoma denyɛ mu a, wɔse: Bɔne biara remma mo so.
Na wɔn mu hwan na wagyina AWURADE agyina no mu,
na wahunu na wate n’asɛm,
anaa hwan na wawɛn n’aso atie n’asɛm?
Hwɛ, AWURADE ahum,
abufuhyeɛ afiri adi,
na ahum a ɛdi kyinhyia
no bɛtwa ne ho abɛsi abɔnefoɔ tiri so.
AWURADE abufuo no rensane
kɔsi sɛ ɛbɛwie na ama n’akoma mu adwene agyina;
nna a ɛdi akyire no mu no
na mobɛhunu mu pefee.
Mansoma adiyifoɔ no,
nso wɔnyaa asɛm kɔkaeɛ;
mankasa mankyerɛ wɔn,
nso wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm.
Na sɛ wɔgyinaa m’agyina mu a,
anka wɔmaa me man tiee me nsɛm,
na wɔasane wɔn afiri wɔn kwammɔne so
ne wɔn nneyɛɛ bɔne no ho.
Meyɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ mpinkyɛeɛ mu, AWURADE asɛm nie, na menyɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ akyirikyiri anaa? Sɛ obi de ne ho hunta huntabea bi a, merenhu no anaa? AWURADE asɛm nie. Ɛnyɛ ɔsoro ne asase na mayɛ so ma anaa? AWURADE asɛm nie. Mate deɛ adiyifoɔ a wɔde me din hyɛ nkɔntorɔ no keka sɛ: Maso daeɛ, maso daeɛ! no. Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn? Ɛwɔ adiyifoɔ a wɔka atorɔ adiyisɛm, na wɔka wɔn akoma mu nnaadaa nkɔm no akoma mu, wɔdwene sɛ wɔbɛma me man werɛ afiri me din, wɔn adaeɛ a wɔkeka kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho no nti, sɛdeɛ Baal nti wɔn agyanom werɛ firii me din no? Odiyifoɔ a ɔso daeɛ no, ma no nka ne daeɛso, na deɛ m’asɛm wɔ ne hɔ no, ma no nka m’asɛm nokorɛ mu. Ɛdeɛn na ntɛtɛ ne ayuo wɔ yɛ? AWURADE asɛm nie. M’asɛm nte sɛ ogya? AWURADE asɛm nie, na ɛnte sɛ asaeɛ a ɛbobɔ ɔbotan anaa? Enti, hwɛ, me ne adiyifoɔ no anya, AWURADE asɛm nie, nnipa a wɔwiawia me nsɛm wɔn yɔnkonom nkyɛn no. Hwɛ, me ne adiyifoɔ no anya, AWURADE asɛm nie, wɔn a wɔde wɔn tɛkyerɛma keka sɛ: AWURADE se, no. Hwɛ, me ne adiyifoɔ a wɔsoso atorɔ adaeɛ no anya, AWURADE asɛm nie; wɔn deɛ, wɔkeka adaeɛ no, na wɔde wɔn atorosɛm ne wɔn adwenharesɛm daadaa me man no, nanso mensomaa wɔn, na menhyɛɛ wɔn, na wɔn ho remma ɔman yi mfasoɔ biara, AWURADE asɛm nie.
Na sɛ ɔman yi, anaa odiyifoɔ anaa ɔsɔfoɔ bi bisa wo sɛ: AWURADE adesoa ne deɛn? Ɛnneɛ kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Wone adesoa no, na mɛto wo matwene, AWURADE asɛm nie. Na odiyifoɔ anaa ɔsɔfoɔ anaa ɔman no mu nipa biara ka sɛ: AWURADE adesoa a, na mɛba mabɛtwe onii ko no ne ne fie aso. Sei na monkeka nkyerɛ mo mfɛfoɔ, na onua nka nkyerɛ ne nua: Ɛdeɛn na AWURADE buaeɛ, na ɛdeɛn na AWURADE aka? Na AWURADE adesoa no deɛ, mommmɔ din bio, na obiara asɛm bɛdane no adesoa, ɛfiri sɛ moadanedane Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ, asafo AWURADE, yɛn Nyankopɔn nsɛm ani. Sei na ka kyerɛ odiyifoɔ no: Ɛdeɛn na AWURADE de buaa woɔ, na ɛdeɛn na AWURADE aka? Na sɛ moka sɛ: AWURADE adesoa no nti, sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɛsiane sɛ moka asɛm yi sɛ AWURADE adesoa no, na mesomaa mo nkyɛn sɛ: Monnka sɛ: AWURADE adesoa no, enti, hwɛ, me werɛ bɛfiri mo koraa, na mato mo ne kuro a mede memaa mo ne mo agyanom no afiri m’anim agu.
Na mede daa ahohora ne daa nsopa a werɛ remfiri da ato mo so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
